analyticGradientSmin.fourTapDeleted: the IQ 4-tap tetrahedron normal (4 full sceneDist evals per lit pixel, each running 3-octave FBM x2 + the sat/trail loops) is DELETED — a ~4-5x field-cost cut on the normal, delivered FREE (the exact trim W16 arm-5 wanted; W16's 'gate the 4-tap behind the lit path' arm is now MOOT).
analyticGradientSmin.squashInverseTranspose: the anisotropic squash basis (bodyUv = D*R*uv) transforms the body gradient too — handled by the INVERSE-TRANSPOSE M^T = R^T*D (scale by diag(1/sa, sa) in the (ax,perp) frame, reconstruct in world), the hazard the SOTA-deepening [2] flagged (the 4-tap did it implicitly via screen-space sampling).

The unit-contract is on the FINAL lifted normal N, NOT the sub-unit raw field gradient — normalize() before the dome lift (preserved).

robustnessFolds.energyConservingBlinnPhong: spec *= (shininess+2)/8 so shininess and strength decouple
robustnessFolds.specularAntialiasing: the spec lobe widens where the FBM normal varies (Toksvig-style fwidth(N) clamp, shininess /= 1+24*nVar) so the tight glint does not STROBE on small dock-grid instances — DROP shininess, not raise it
robustnessFolds.beerLambertSSS: the linear coreGlow*thickness -> a saturating 1-exp(-3*thickness) curve (flat thick core, fast warm rim falloff); the SSS hue-warm-shift scaled by (1-thickness) so only the thin rim warms
robustnessFolds.ignDither: interleaved-gradient noise at 1/255 AFTER linearToSrgb, BEFORE the *alpha premultiply — the low-chroma warm-cream dome no longer bands on 8-bit panels (aurora ships the same splice)
